'''Eanis Malavoy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who worked as a buyer for [[Bonadan Heavy Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], he attended a conclave of Rebel sympathizers on [[Kiamurr]]. Malavoy had a liking for [[lemon cake]]s.
